GenAiPlugin.description: Analyze and match volunteer skills with crisis needs. This topic is chosen when a request involves identifying suitable volunteers based on their skills.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about identifying volunteers with specific skills, use EmployeeCopilot__validateSegmentMember.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only match volunteer skills with crisis requirements. This includes analyzing volunteer profiles and identifying those who fit the specific needs of a crisis.
